requestedScope: One bounded version-filtered tail session and cleanup, two read-only production health checks, and analytics and management readback.
At most one conditional deployment restoring 100% v108 under the exact rollback guard.

selection.rationale: Limit first exposure while gathering version-attributed production evidence. At the observed hourly rate, 5% over 45 minutes corresponds to about 14 invocations. Actual volume can vary.

authority.account: Resolve only from the verified Labs config pinned in the migration receipt and compare the Stage 1 config.

preWriteGuards: Verify this packet and linked migration and upload receipts by full SHA-256.
Recheck v108 at 100% on the exact pinned deployment, v109 latest and at 0%, v106 preserved at 0%, and both traffic versions listed deployable.
Check immutable modules, version-bound v109 map, all binding identities and values, runtime, exports, Worker settings, cron, exposure and exact production hostnames.
Read the exact Labs BRIDGE_DB on the primary and verify the post-0104 schema, ledger and zero admissions.
Confirm the authenticated GraphQL outcome query returns the current v108 and that the new version-filtered tail connects. Stop before the forward POST if monitoring or the v108 control probe fails.
Re-read the deployment and latest version immediately before the single POST. The Cloudflare deployment endpoint provides no compare-and-swap guard in this procedure.

annotations.workers/message: Finite Cambium pilot v109 canary 5 percent with v108 at 95 percent.

forward.readback: Record the returned deployment ID. Require that ID active and exact 95/5 assignment by independent deployment GET.

control.timing: Before the traffic POST while the pinned v108 deployment serves 100%

candidate.timing: After the exact split is active
candidate.attestation: Require the matching request marker from the v109-filtered tail. The response body alone cannot prove which version served it.

tail.status: List endpoint read verified. Connect under future approval before deployment.
tail.output: Reduce in memory to version, host, probe marker, HTTP status and outcome. Keep only counts and sanitized evidence.
tail.cleanup: Close only the tail opened for this canary on exit.

analytics.purpose: Version-attributed invocation outcomes for the matching interval.
analytics.qualification: The earlier candidate preview also appeared with isPreview=0. Use the version-filtered tail and hostname allowlist for production attribution.

monitoring.acceptance: Exact active split, both health checks, the v109 tail attribution for its probe, at least eight other observed v109 production invocations, and no rollback trigger throughout the window.
monitoring.onPass: Keep the approved 95/5 split. A promotion or larger allocation requires a new approval before the native workflow uses v109.

annotations.workers/message: Finite Cambium pilot canary rollback to v108 at 100 percent.

triggers: After the forward deployment, the candidate health probe fails or lacks the matching v109 tail event within 120 seconds.
Any v109 production invocation shows an HTTP 5xx or a runtime failure such as an exception, CPU or memory limit, or internal error.
Loss of required monitoring for 120 seconds or failure to meet the observation minimum by 45 minutes.
conditionalRollback.guard: Require the active deployment ID equals the deployment created by this canary and its allocations still match 95/5. Recheck the v108 rollback pin and shared live pins. Stop on drift.
conditionalRollback.readback: Record the inverse deployment ID and verify that deployment is active at v108 100%. Verify v106 and v109 at 0% and the retained D1 schema, bindings, settings, exposure, and cron.
conditionalRollback.uncertainty: Resolve the original request with management reads. Never repeat either POST based only on a timeout. A superseding deployment requires a new decision.
